description: A homeowner with a large chest freezer must decide whether to lend it to a neighbor catering a volunteer picnic, in exchange for cash and boxed lunches, while the picnic coordinator helps settle the food-safety terms.

shared_context.S1: Maya has a working chest freezer in her garage that is large enough for a neighborhood picnic's prepared food.
shared_context.S2: Jon wants to use the freezer for a weekend catering job, and Rina is coordinating the picnic where the food will be served.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final decision about whether the freezer is lent and what informal terms are agreed.

PF1.text: Jon's offer is exactly $90 in cash plus exactly 30 boxed vegetarian lunches, delivered Saturday at noon, in exchange for freezer use from Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.

PF2.text: One registered picnic attendee has a severe sesame allergy, so every lunch must be sesame-free and prepared with separate utensils and surfaces; Rina must state this requirement during the round-robin check.

acceptance_conditions: The freezer-lending deal must be approved.
Jon must pay exactly $90 in cash.
Exactly 30 boxed vegetarian lunches must be included.
The lunches must be delivered Saturday at noon.
The freezer-use window must run from Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.
The lunches must be prepared with separate utensils and surfaces.
A food-safety commitment covering all lunches must be logged.
Rina's allergy information must be spoken aloud by Rina and cited by Maya in the justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions['freezer_use_window'] in ['Friday at 6:00 p.m. through Sunday at 6:00 p.m.', 'Friday 6:00 p.m. through Sunday 6:00 p.m.', 'Friday 6 PM through Sunday 6 PM']
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'food_safety' and c['target'] == 'all lunches' and 'sesame-free' in c['detail'] and 'separate utensils and surfaces' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jon's exact offer changes the settlement to exactly $90, exactly 30 lunches, Saturday-at-noon delivery, and the Friday-evening-through-Sunday-evening freezer window.

Rina's allergy information changes the food terms to sesame-free lunches prepared with separate utensils and surfaces, requires a logged food-safety commitment, and gives Maya the specific fact to cite.
